lines.text: Everyone has a psalm, teaching, revelation, tongue, or interpretation, and all must build up the church.
Two, or at most seven, should speak in a tongue in turn, and someone must interpret.
If a revelation comes to someone seated, the first speaker should stop so all may prophesy in turn.
God is a God of peace, and women with questions are to ask their own fathers at home.
Be eager to prophesy, do not forbid speaking in tongues, and do everything in a proper and orderly manner.
